newsHighlights.title: Xi advances conservation with people at heart
newsHighlights.summary: Fish have returned to the once-dried-up Huangqihai Lake in Inner Mongolia, showcasing the remarkable results of ecological restoration.
newsHighlights.translation: 曾经干涸的内蒙古黄旗海重现鱼类，彰显生态修复的显著成果。

newsHighlights.title: Xi: Prioritize ecological conservation
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping urged that ecological conservation be prioritized while advancing green and low-carbon development.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席强调要坚持生态优先，推进绿色低碳发展。

newsHighlights.title: Red spirit spurs green growth
newsHighlights.summary: China is turning its revolutionary heritage into a driving force for sustainable green economic growth.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国正将革命精神转化为推动绿色可持续经济增长的动力。

newsHighlights.title: Yin Yuzhen plants a tree in FAO headquarters
newsHighlights.summary: Chinese desert-fighting heroine Yin Yuzhen planted a tree at the FAO headquarters, sharing China's experience in combating desertification.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国治沙英雄殷玉珍在联合国粮农组织总部植树，分享中国防沙治沙经验。

newsHighlights.title: Xi stresses sound planning for the computing power industry
newsHighlights.summary: Ulaanqab in Inner Mongolia has made significant progress in developing its green computing industry powered by clean energy.
newsHighlights.translation: 内蒙古乌兰察布在发展以清洁能源为支撑的绿色算力产业方面取得重大进展。

quote.quote: The Earth does not belong to us: we belong to the Earth.
quote.author: Chief Seattle
quote.translation: 地球不属于我们：我们属于地球。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒人类并非自然的主宰者，而是生态系统的一部分。今日新闻中黄旗海生态修复、防沙治沙的成果，正是人类尊重自然、与自然和谐共生的生动体现。

vocabulary.definition: （对自然环境、资源的）保护；保存
vocabulary.example: Xi advances conservation with people at the heart of every policy.
vocabulary.translation: 推进以人民为中心的生态保护。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「Xi advances conservation with people at heart」。

vocabulary.example: The return of fish to Huangqihai Lake highlights the results of ecological restoration.
vocabulary.translation: 鱼类重返黄旗海凸显了生态修复的成果。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Fish have returned to the Huangqihai Lake... highlighting the results of ecological restoration」。

vocabulary.example: The recovery of the lake highlights the effectiveness of local environmental measures.
vocabulary.translation: 湖泊的恢复凸显了当地环境治理措施的成效。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「highlighting the results of ecological restoration」。

vocabulary.example: China will prioritize ecological conservation in its future development.
vocabulary.translation: 中国将在未来发展中把生态保护放在优先位置。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「Xi: Prioritize ecological conservation」。

vocabulary.example: The country is committed to sustainable green economic growth.
vocabulary.translation: 该国致力于可持续的绿色经济增长。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Red spirit spurs green growth」中关于可持续发展的表述。

vocabulary.example: Yin Yuzhen has spent decades combating desertification in northern China.
vocabulary.translation: 殷玉珍数十年来一直在中国北方与荒漠化作斗争。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Yin Yuzhen plants a tree in FAO headquarters」中的治沙主题。

vocabulary.example: Planting trees is one of the most effective ways to fight desertification.
vocabulary.translation: 植树造林是防治荒漠化最有效的方法之一。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Yin Yuzhen plants a tree in FAO headquarters」中分享治沙经验的主题。

vocabulary.example: Huangqihai Lake, which once dried up, is now home to fish again.
vocabulary.translation: 曾经干涸的黄旗海如今重新有了鱼类栖息。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Fish have returned to the Huangqihai Lake... which once dried up」。

vocabulary.example: Ulaanqab's green computing industry relies heavily on renewable energy.
vocabulary.translation: 乌兰察布的绿色算力产业高度依赖可再生能源。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Xi stresses sound planning for the computing power industry」中绿色算力与清洁能源的主题。

vocabulary.example: China is turning its revolutionary heritage into a driving force for green growth.
vocabulary.translation: 中国正将革命精神遗产转化为绿色增长的动力。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Red spirit spurs green growth」中的表述。

pattern.pattern: Sth. + highlights / shows + the results / effectiveness of ...（某事凸显了……的成效）
pattern.example: Fish have returned to the Huangqihai Lake, highlighting the results of ecological restoration.
pattern.translation: 鱼类重返黄旗海，凸显了生态修复的成效。
pattern.usage: 用于描述某一现象或事件所体现出的成果与效果。highlighting 为现在分词作伴随状语，也可改写为 which highlights...。类似结构：The data highlights the importance of...（数据凸显了……的重要性）。

grammar.title: 现在分词作结果/伴随状语（Present Participle as Adverbial）
grammar.explanation: 在新闻英语中，常用「主句 + doing...」结构，其中现在分词短语表示主句动作带来的结果或伴随情况。分词的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。这种结构使句子更简洁紧凑，是新闻标题和导语的高频句式。
examples: Fish have returned to the Huangqihai Lake, highlighting the results of ecological restoration.
China is turning its revolutionary heritage into a driving force for green growth, spurring sustainable development across the country.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第三个音节 /ˈlɒdʒ/。/iː/ 为长元音，发音饱满；/dʒ/ 是浊辅音，舌尖抵住硬腭后突然放开。整体节奏为「e-co-LO-gi-cal」，中间音节最重，前后音节轻读。
examples: Ecological conservation has become a national priority in China.
The ecological restoration of the lake took nearly a decade.

reading.title: From Dried-Up Lake to Thriving Waters: China's Green Progress
reading.content:
In the cold, windy grasslands of Ulaanqab, Inner Mongolia, a quiet miracle has taken place. Huangqihai Lake, which completely dried up years ago due to climate change and overuse of water, is now filled with water again. Fish have returned, and birds follow. 

This is not an accident. It is the result of years of ecological restoration work — replanting grass, controlling pollution and carefully managing water resources. During a recent visit to the area, President Xi Jinping stressed that ecological conservation must be prioritized, and that green, low-carbon development should guide future growth.

The region is also finding new ways to grow without harming the environment. Ulaanqab is building a green computing industry powered by clean energy, turning its cool climate and wind resources into advantages. Meanwhile, desert-fighting heroine Yin Yuzhen planted a tree at the FAO headquarters in Rome, sharing China's experience in combating desertification with the world.

As Chief Seattle once said, the Earth does not belong to us — we belong to the Earth. China's green story reminds us that when people respect nature, nature responds with life.
reading.translation:
在内蒙古乌兰察布寒冷多风的草原上，一个悄然发生的奇迹正在上演。数年前因气候变化和水资源过度利用而彻底干涸的黄旗海，如今重新蓄满了水。鱼类回来了，鸟儿也随之而来。

这并非偶然，而是多年来生态修复工作的成果——补种牧草、治理污染、科学管理水资源。习近平主席近日在考察该地区时强调，必须坚持生态优先，以绿色低碳发展引领未来增长。

该地区还在探索不破坏环境的新发展路径。乌兰察布正依托清洁能源建设绿色算力产业，将凉爽的气候和风能资源转化为发展优势。与此同时，治沙英雄殷玉珍在罗马联合国粮农组织总部植树，向世界分享中国的防沙治沙经验。

正如西雅图酋长所言：地球不属于我们——我们属于地球。中国的绿色故事提醒我们：当人类尊重自然，自然便会以生机回应。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 China Daily 2026年10月19日多篇真实报道改写，包括「Xi advances conservation with people at heart」「Xi: Prioritize ecological conservation」「Yin Yuzhen plants a tree in FAO headquarters」「Xi stresses sound planning for the computing power industry」「Red spirit spurs green growth」，内容为教学改写版本。
